newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah plunges on speculative attack.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah plunges on speculative attack.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah plunged against the dollar in nervous trading on Monday, with offshore players seen sustaining a speculative attack, dealers said.

"We have become the main target today. Offshore players seem to switch focus to the rupiah after they had launched attacks last week on the ringgit and the Singapore dollar," one dealer in Singapore said.
Spot rupiah was quoted at 2,620/30 at 0250 GMT, compared with an opening at 2,510/20.
